name: acclorite-m11-transfer-v1
description: M11 transfer corpus sealed before Experiment G results. It uses different command families from research-v1/heldout-v1 to test whether bounded semantic retrieval support generalizes beyond repeatedly inspected benchmark capabilities.

cases.query: resolve this messy path into its absolute canonical location
show where this symbolic link actually points
show this file's size permissions timestamps and inode metadata
create a safely unique temporary file or directory name
kill this command automatically if it runs longer than thirty seconds
start this program with less cpu scheduling priority
change the scheduling priority of a process that is already running
restrict a process so it can run only on selected cpu cores
run a command only while holding an exclusive file lock
list the linux namespaces currently present on the system
enter the namespaces belonging to another running process
launch a program inside a new isolated linux namespace
tell me how long the machine has been running and its load averages
show used available and free system memory
continuously report virtual memory paging cpu and process statistics
convert lowercase letters arriving on stdin into uppercase
combine corresponding lines from two files side by side
merge two sorted text files by a shared key field
copy stdin to the terminal and a file at the same time
print text with a line number in front of each line
randomize the order of the input lines
generate a sequence of integers from one through one hundred
print a file starting from its last line and working upward
wrap long input lines so none exceed a chosen column width
show my numeric user id group id and group memberships
print the environment variables available to this process
